metadata.title: SPARC Azure Managed Disk Component Definition

components.title: Azure Managed Disk
components.description: Managed data disk attached to the VM for persistent application data storage, with Azure-managed encryption at rest and configurable storage account type. Deployed via Terraform (Azure/VM/modules/storage/). <!-- UPDATE: Insert managed disk ID, VM attachment details, and disk size for your deployment. -->

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control implementations for Azure Managed Disk

implemented-requirements.description: Protection of Information at Rest: The managed data disk is encrypted at rest using Azure Storage Service Encryption with platform-managed AES-256 keys. All data, snapshots, and temporary storage associated with the disk are automatically encrypted. The disk uses a configurable storage account type (e.g., Premium_LRS, StandardSSD_LRS) and is created as an empty disk with a specified size. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000231, CIS Azure 7.3.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Terraform resources: azurerm_managed_disk.data with configurable storage_account_type, azurerm_virtual_machine_data_disk_attachment.data. Azure encrypts all managed disks by default with platform-managed keys.

implemented-requirements.description: System Backup: Azure Managed Disks support Azure Backup integration for automated point-in-time snapshots and recovery. The disk is created with a specified zone for availability. Azure Backup can be configured to perform daily incremental backups with configurable retention policies. Disk snapshots can also be created on-demand for pre-change backup points. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000065.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Terraform resource: azurerm_managed_disk.data. Azure Backup vault and backup policy should be configured separately for production deployments.
